## Problem and change

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue.

## Validation

List commands actually run and results. Identify checks not run and why.
Distinguish public-source proof from installed-owner or release qualification.

## Scope and compatibility

Note affected document/schema/package versions and any behavior change.
Preserve licenses, attribution and historical evidence. Exclude secrets/private data.

External contributors do not need native cards or private tooling. Maintainers
perform native review/admission and add the correct closing relation before delivery.
